name: Planet Labs (PlanetScope + SkySat)
description: ~150 PlanetScope 3U CubeSats + ~21 SkySats at 475 km sun-synchronous — daily-revisit Earth imaging. PlanetScope gives 3-5 m global daily; SkySats give 50 cm on-demand tasking. Every patch of Earth's land surface photographed every day.
scale_fact: Planet's Doves fleet generates roughly 25 terabytes of imagery per day — more than NASA's entire Earth-observation programme.
